specs.value: Bluetooth dimming controller for Chihiros LED lights; not a light itself
4 channels (red, green, blue, white), each adjusted on its own
My Chihiros (formerly Chihiros Magic), for iOS and Android
Daily light schedule with sunrise, midday pause and sunset presets, a light-curve graph and stepless dimming; built-in timer
Seller says it keeps brightness settings after a power cut
Constant-voltage LED lamps under 36 V and up to 100 W (third-party copy of the manual; the model it covers is unclear)
Indoor use only; keep away from water and damp
6 months from delivery (Shrimp Home's policy for Chihiros spare parts)
CHI-094-COM4
WRGB, Vivid and A Plus RGB series
A, A Plus, C, E, S, RGB, X100, X200 and Wabi-kusa lights
All LEDs dimmed together; no separate colour channels

fits.fact: Made for the original Chihiros WRGB lights, and Vivid and A Plus RGB lights too
One Indian seller says the 36V version of A Plus RGB is not supported
Not for A, C, E, S or Wabi-kusa lights; those use Commander 1
Newer WRGB II models have Bluetooth control built in, so they don't need a separate Commander 4
Without the controller, a WRGB light only gives steady colours and has no timer
Vietnamese shops sell it as a replacement when the controller that came with a WRGB light breaks

usage.fact: Connects between the light and its power supply, then you set it up from a phone with the My Chihiros app
You can set an on-time for the day and an off-time for the night, so no separate timer is needed
Keep it indoors and dry; don't put it where it can get wet
For the WRGB light it controls: mount it at least 6 cm above the water, unplug it before cleaning, and keep the power adapter off the tank lid

issues.fact: Users report the app sometimes can't find the Commander 4 during setup
On a UK forum, hobbyists blamed the controller itself more than the app for problems; Chihiros reportedly changed its electronics later without announcing it
Bluetooth connections across Chihiros devices drop, and users often fix this by restarting the app; some use open-source Home Assistant control instead
The seller says settings survive a power cut, but one buyer said the light stayed off after an outage
All Commander 4 colour channels are set separately, unlike Commander 1, which dims everything together
Stock is thin in Vietnam: several shops show it or the bundles as sold out

alternatives.why: For a new build this is better than an old WRGB plus Commander 4, because the controller is built in. Thủy Sinh Tím lists the 60 cm at 3,150,000₫
Cheaper (210,000₫ at Shrimp Home) for single-channel A/C/Wabi-kusa lights, but it can't adjust colours separately
A Chihiros RGB light sold in Vietnam in several lengths, priced 1,810,000–3,620,000₫ at Shrimp Home (currently out of stock)
